subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime-object layer: float-to-packed-field encoders (color, fixed-point, bitfield control words) used by vehicle orientation/lighting paths, a pit-stall circular buffer pool with worker assignment and drain-to-list processing, small-struct zero-init wrappers, a global-data-backed object initializer, a deterministic hash PRNG, a scaled stream-value reader, a steering interpolation queue with mode flag and animation-phase dispatch, and a render-toggle wrapper.

summary: A heterogeneous set of runtime objects and packers. PitStallBufferPool (0x004B71E0 init, 0x004B6130 cleanup, 0x004B6190 worker assignment, 0x004B7860 drain-to-list, 0x004B6360 alignment comparator) owns a circular buffer of 176-byte pit-stall entries at +0x9B0 (count +0x9B4 chosen from enum +0x9A4, write/read indices +0x9B8/+0x9BC reset to -1), a file-stream node list at +0x6C0..+0x6D0, a working list at +0x30 and a doubly-linked result list at +0x714..+0x720. A family of float-to-packed-field encoders writes packed color (PackedColorChannelWriter 0x004B21F0), packed vertex shorts (PackedVertexShortWriter 0x004B2310), fixed-point scalars (FixedPointParameterEncoder 0x004B25D0/0x004B2750), indexed bytes/shorts (IndexedFixedPointEncoder 0x004B2840) and three bit ranges of the control dword at +0x2C plus a 10-bit field at +0x30 (PackedBitfieldControlWord 0x004B2930/0x004B29B0/0x004B2A40/0x004B2B10); the shared caller set (0x004B2DD0, 0x004B32A0, 0x004C71C0) suggests a vehicle orientation/lighting parameter object but ownership is UNKNOWN. DeterministicHashPRNG (0x004B3C60) is an LCG/RDTSC/GetTickCount mixing PRNG with accumulator at +0x804. ScaledStreamValueReader (0x004B4360) reads a header, then a raw or scaled float value plus a payload. SmallStructZeroInitializer (0x004B4450/0x004B4460) zeroes a 10-byte struct. GlobalDataInitializedObject (0x004B4F50/0x004B4F70) initializes a sub-object at +0x90 and writes sentinel 0xF49C952E to +0x84/+0x88/+0x8C. SteeringInterpolationObject (0x004B8790 getter, 0x004B87A0 queue peek, 0x004B9A00 mode flag, 0x004B9A10 progress ratio) reads queue fields +0xF30/+0xF34/+0xF38 and the +0xF81 mode flag / +0xF84 offset, feeding SteeringAckermannComputation; AnimationPhaseUpdater (0x004B8C40) dispatches phase updates through FloatGetter. RenderToggleDispatcher (0x004B97E0) forwards a render toggle into sub_4B7500. All packet owners are UnknownObject/UNKNOWN; class groupings here are DERIVED/GUESS synthesis.

function_roles.role: Packed RGB color writer: clamps three float channels to [-65535.988, 65535.988] (flt_5ACC88/flt_5ACC8C), scales in-range channels by 32768.0 (flt_5ACC84), truncates to int, and packs a 40-bit color across word +0x0, word +0x4 and byte +0x8; returns the top byte of the third channel.

Packed vertex short writer: copies three dwords from a2 into this+0x0/+0x4/+0x8, then converts three float inputs into signed 16-bit values at +0xC/+0xE/+0x10 with clamp to -32767/0x7FFF (flt_5ACC90/flt_5ACC94) and scale 2048.0 (flt_59E714); returns the final converted value.

Float-to-fixed-point converter with clamp: a2[0] to byte +0x24 (scale 20.0 flt_59E8EC, clamp globals flt_5ACCA0/flt_5ACCA4), a2[1] to short +0x26 (scale 500.0 flt_59E91C, clamp globals flt_5ACCA8/flt_5ACCAC), a2[2] to byte +0x25 (returned); out-of-range clamps to signed sentinels.

Float-to-short clamped converter: converts a2[0] (scale 512.0 flt_5ACCB4, clamp flt_5ACCB8/flt_5ACCBC to 0x7FFF/-32767) into short +0x28 and a2[2] into short +0x2A (returned); the middle element a2[1] is not read.

Indexed fixed-point encoder: clamps a3 to [-0.49599999, 0.49599999], scales by 256.0 and stores a byte at this[a2 + 18]; clamps a4 to [-327.67001, 327.67001], scales by 100.0 and stores a 16-bit value at this[2*a2 + 22]; returns that encoded short. Used by SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0).

Bitfield packer (bits 17-31): multiplies the input float by 10.0 (flt_59E5FC), truncates, clamps to [0, 0x7FFF], shifts left 17 and merges into bits 17-31 of the dword at this+0x2C preserving the low 17 bits; returns the packed value.

Bitfield insert (bits 12-16): multiplies the input float by 31.0 (flt_5ACCD0), truncates to unsigned 8-bit, shifts left 12 and XOR-merges a 5-bit value into bits 12-16 (mask 0x1F000) of the dword at this+0x2C preserving all other bits; returns the computed field value.

Bitfield encoder (bits 0-6): multiplies the input float by 63.0 (flt_5ACCD8), truncates to unsigned 8-bit, subtracts the 64 bias and masks to 7 bits, then merges the biased signed value into bits 0-6 of the dword at this+0x2C clearing bits 0-6 and preserving bits 7-31; returns the new dword.

10-bit packer (bits 22-31): scales the input float by 3.0 (flt_59E478), truncates, shifts left 22 into bits 22-31 of the dword at this+0x30 while preserving the lower 22 bits (mask 0xFF3FFFFF); stores and returns the updated dword. Invoked by SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0).

Deterministic entropy-mixing PRNG: updates the multiplicative accumulator at this+0x804 with the LCG step 219837*(this[513]+2), mixes in the RDTSC timestamp (0x0055687B), reads a float noise sample via the auto-incrementing byte counter at this+0x0, combines GetTickCount (0x0059E0D4) via CRTFtol (0x00587BDC), RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator (0x005884ED) and the accumulated timestamp; returns (2*v9+1)*v7+v11.

Stream-value reader with conditional scaling: calls FileWriteWithBackendDispatch (0x00566C00) to populate a 4-byte header; based on header bits either stores the incoming float a2 raw or scales a single stream byte by dbl_5ACD28 (0.0001670000056037679) into v3+4; then reads a payload of (header >> 8) & 0x3FF bytes into v3+8 and returns 0.

Pass-through wrapper: invokes SmallStructZeroInit (0x004B4460) with no arguments for its side effect and returns the incoming this pointer unchanged; its four callers (allocation/audio helpers) call it for the zero-init effect.
Unconditional 10-byte struct zero-initializer: writes 0 to the dword at +0x0, the dword at +0x4 and the word at +0x8; always returns 0. Called by the wrapper and buffer-transfer helpers.
Construction wrapper: initializes the sub-object at this+144 via PassthroughWrapper_f670 (0x004FF670), then calls StructInitWithGlobalData (0x004B4F70) on this and returns this.

Struct init from global data: delegates sub-struct initialization at this+0x90 to ThunkWithStructInitSubCalls (0x004FFFA0), zeroes four byte fields (+0x0, +0x1, +0x41, +0x61), then writes the sentinel dword -190986834 (0xF49C952E, flt_5ACD10) into +0x84, +0x88 and +0x8C; returns the sentinel.

Overlay/sprite array cleanup: frees the heap array of 176-byte entries stored at this + 0x9B0, reading the count from the header dword at (array - 4), walking backward calling QuadrupleListCleanup (0x004B46F0) per entry, freeing the header block via FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF), then zeroing +0x9B0 and +0x9B4; returns the freed pointer value (zero on the normal path).

Pit crew worker allocation for driver a2: skips when the vehicle slot dword_5EF9A0[4656*a2] is inactive (-1); per worker slot (4 iterations) scans the pit-stall circular buffer (176-byte entries at +0x9B0) via CircularBufferCheck/HashTableLookup collecting up to 12 matches, marks with BitfieldSetter_4800, sorts with MultiStageAlignmentComparator (0x004B6360), and assigns via sub_4B4A30 when at least 9 match; returns i + 1.

Multi-stage alignment comparator: validates the header words of *a2 (top-bit tag and reserved bit mask), optionally compares 14 flag bits of a2[2] against a4[2] via BitTest (0x004B2AD0) when the difficulty selector at this+0x9AC is 3 or 4, populates comparison intermediates (0x004B3A90, 0x004B2420), then runs stage 0 (per-component scalar differences through LapSpeedComparisonWithSwitchSelectableThresholds 0x004B66E0) and stage 1 (wrapped per-axis angle differences through SteeringAlignmentToleranceCheck 0x004B67D0); returns 1 when all pass, else 0.

Buffer-pool reinitialization: transfers the linked buffer (0x004B5F60), runs the companion setup (0x004B5E50), tears down and clears the file-stream node list at +0x6C0..+0x6D0, rebuilds the list at +0xF38/+0xF3C (0x004B52A0), resets write/read indices +0x9B8/+0x9BC to -1, sets the counter at +0xF8C to 5, runs overlay-list cleanup, selects the entry count from the enum at +0x9A4 (0=16, 1=24, 2=32, 3=48, 4=96) into +0x9B4, allocates the 176-byte-entry circular buffer (176*count+4) at +0x9B0 and zero-initializes each 44-byte sub-entry.

Circular-buffer drain to doubly-linked result list: entry guard on the buffer count (+0x9B4), loops the working list at +0x30 feeding the 176-byte slot selected at +0x9B0 by the read index +0x9BC into CollisionObjectListManagement (0x004B4B50), accumulates +0xF24/+0xF28, appends 16-byte result nodes to the list at +0x714..+0x720, synthesizes nodes via the working list when empty, then advances the read index via RingBufferCounterWithWrap (0x004B69D0) and returns 1 (or 0 when the buffer was not ready).

Float getter: reads element index 974 (byte offset 0xF38) of the float array referenced by this and returns it as double; no side effects, no branches. Shared field accessor called by eight helpers (StateTriggerCheck, Delegation, FloatAccumulator, ConditionalMultiPathDispatcher and neighbors).

Non-destructive queue peek: copies this[972] (+0xF30) into *a2 and this[973] (+0xF34) into *a3, returns constant 1; never writes the source. Five helpers (0x004B70B0, 0x004B9A10, 0x004B9C80, 0x004B9E40, 0x004BA1F0) read the two queued values.

Animation/simulation phase update dispatcher: switches on the mode value a2 through jump table global:0x004B8D8C, each mode fetches the base float via FloatGetter (0x004B8790), adds/subtracts the cooling-rate global dbl_8AFE90 with per-mode scalars (1.0, 0.083333336, 3.3399999) or applies a floor clamp, runs AngleClampWrap (0x004B86E0), writes phase identifiers 4-7 and scale factors; modes 0/2/3/4 fall through to ShortComputation_8d70 (0x004C8D70) and GuardedVirtualCall (0x004C8DC0), mode 1 returns ArithmeticComparison_8d60 (0x004C8D60) early.
Render toggle refresh wrapper: forwards the object's first dword and the boolean (dword_7D0038 != 0) into sub_4B7500 and returns the callee's result directly.

Angle clamp mode flag reader: dereferences the pointer at this+0 to reach the object, reads the byte at object offset 0xF81 (3969) and returns it; zero = wrap, non-zero = hard clamp (interpretation from existing analysis, not confirmed by this function).

Normalised progress ratio compute: dereferences this to the object, reads the range lower/upper bounds via QueuePeek (0x004B87A0), branches on the mode flag at obj+0xF81: clamp mode uses dbl_8AFEA0 minus obj+0xF84, wrap mode uses the range width; calls Delegation (0x004B9CE0) and returns (value - v8) / v9, or 0.0 when the range is <= 0. Feeds SteeringAckermannComputation (0x004DB170).

classes.name: PitStallBufferPool
classes.responsibility: Owns the pit-stall circular buffer of 176-byte entries: initializes it from an entry-count enum and a file-stream node list (0x004B71E0), cleans it up entry-by-entry (0x004B6130), allocates pit crew workers over its entries (0x004B6190), sorts/compares entries through the multi-stage alignment comparator (0x004B6360), and drains a slot into a doubly-linked result list (0x004B7860).

classes.name: PackedBitfieldControlWord
classes.responsibility: Writes the packed bitfield dwords of a per-vehicle render/orientation parameter object: bits 17-31 (15-bit, 0x004B2930), bits 12-16 (5-bit, 0x004B29B0), bits 0-6 (7-bit biased, 0x004B2A40) of the dword at +0x2C, and bits 22-31 (10-bit, 0x004B2B10) of the dword at +0x30.

classes.name: FixedPointParameterEncoder
classes.responsibility: Converts float triples/pairs into clamped fixed-point scalar fields of a parameter object (byte +0x24/+0x25, short +0x26/+0x28/+0x2A); called by VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles, sub_4B32A0 and SetupCarLightingAndRender.

classes.name: PackedColorChannelWriter
classes.responsibility: Packs three float color channels into a 40-bit RGB representation spread across word +0x0, word +0x4 and byte +0x8, with clamp to [-65535.988, 65535.988] and scale 32768.0.

classes.name: PackedVertexShortWriter
classes.responsibility: Copies three dwords verbatim into +0x0/+0x4/+0x8 then converts three floats into clamped signed 16-bit values at +0xC/+0xE/+0x10 (scale 2048.0); candidate packed vertex/vector writer.

classes.name: IndexedFixedPointEncoder
classes.responsibility: Encodes a clamped/scaled byte and short into an index-offset buffer (byte at this[a2+18], short at this[2*a2+22]) for indexed parameter packing by SetupCarLightingAndRender.

classes.name: DeterministicHashPRNG
classes.responsibility: Entropy-mixing pseudo-random DWORD generator: LCG step over the accumulator at +0x804 mixed with RDTSC, a float noise table sample indexed by the byte counter at +0x0, GetTickCount and an internal LCG call.

classes.name: ScaledStreamValueReader
classes.responsibility: Reads a header then either a raw float or a byte scaled by dbl_5ACD28 plus a payload block from a backend stream (0x00566C00), writing header/value/payload into a caller buffer.

classes.name: SmallStructZeroInitializer
classes.responsibility: Zeroes a 10-byte struct (dword +0x0, dword +0x4, word +0x8); 0x004B4460 is the zero-initializer proper, 0x004B4450 a pass-through wrapper invoking it for its side effect on behalf of allocation/audio callers.

classes.name: GlobalDataInitializedObject
classes.responsibility: Initializes an object from global data: construction wrapper 0x004B4F50 initializes the sub-object at +0x90 (via 0x004FF670) then runs 0x004B4F70, which initializes the sub-struct at +0x90 (via 0x004FFFA0), zeroes byte fields +0x0/+0x1/+0x41/+0x61 and writes sentinel 0xF49C952E (flt_5ACD10) to +0x84/+0x88/+0x8C.

classes.name: SteeringInterpolationObject
classes.responsibility: Steering/animation interpolation state: exposes the float at +0xF38 (0x004B8790), two queued range values at +0xF30/+0xF34 (0x004B87A0), the angle clamp mode flag at obj+0xF81 (0x004B9A00) and the normalised progress ratio over that range (0x004B9A10, feeding SteeringAckermannComputation).

classes.name: AnimationPhaseUpdater
classes.responsibility: Dispatches an animation/simulation phase update by a mode value: adjusts the base float read via FloatGetter by the cooling-rate global dbl_8AFE90 with per-mode scalars, clamps the angle, and writes phase identifiers and scale factors; mode 1 returns early via ArithmeticComparison_8d60.

classes.name: RenderToggleDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Thin wrapper forwarding the object's first dword and the dword_7D0038 boolean into sub_4B7500 as a render toggle / scene refresh operation.

transitions.condition: LODWORD(a2)==0: v19 = FloatGetter(this) - dbl_8AFE90 with floor clamp, phase id 4 written, falls through to shared tail
LODWORD(a2)==1: v14 = FloatGetter(this), returns ArithmeticComparison_8d60 early, phase id 5
LODWORD(a2)==2: v15 = FloatGetter(this) + dbl_8AFE90, phase id 6, falls through to shared tail
LODWORD(a2)==3: v16 = FloatGetter(this) + dbl_8AFE90*0.083333336, scale 1056964608, phase id 6, falls through to shared tail
LODWORD(a2)==4: v17 = FloatGetter(this) + dbl_8AFE90*3.3399999, scale 1070973583, phase id 7, falls through to shared tail
entry guard passes (buffer count equals this[621] at +0x9B4, or force flag a2 set, and count > 0)
one slot drained via CollisionObjectListManagement and the read index advanced by RingBufferCounterWithWrap (0x004B69D0)

interfaces.name: IPackedFieldEncoder
interfaces.purpose: Float-to-packed-field encoder family: clamps, scales and packs float inputs into fixed-point bytes/shorts or bitfield dwords of a per-vehicle orientation/lighting parameter object. Shared caller set: VehicleOrientationFromEulerAngles (0x004B2DD0), sub_4B32A0 (0x004B32A0) and SetupCarLightingAndRender (0x004C71C0).

interfaces.name: IPitStallBufferPool
interfaces.purpose: Lifecycle of the 176-byte-entry pit-stall circular buffer: initialization (0x004B71E0), cleanup (0x004B6130), pit crew worker allocation (0x004B6190) and slot drain into a result list (0x004B7860).

compatibility_contracts.name: PackedColorFormatContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The 40-bit packed color output must preserve the channel encoding of 0x004B21F0: each of three float channels clamped to [-65535.988, 65535.988] (flt_5ACC88/flt_5ACC8C) with INT_MIN/INT_MAX saturation, scaled by 32768.0 (flt_5ACC84), then bit-packed as word +0x0, word +0x4 and byte +0x8; the top byte of the third channel is the function result.

compatibility_contracts.name: PitStallBufferLayoutContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The pit-stall buffer pool must keep its circular buffer of 176-byte entries at +0x9B0 with the entry count at +0x9B4 selected from the enum at +0x9A4 (0=16, 1=24, 2=32, 3=48, 4=96), write/read indices at +0x9B8/+0x9BC reset to -1 on init, allocation size 176*count+4 with the count header at (array-4), and cleanup walking the entries backward via QuadrupleListCleanup before freeing the header block.

compatibility_contracts.name: BitfieldControlWordContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The packed control dword at +0x2C must preserve three independently written bit ranges: bits 0-6 hold a 64-biased 7-bit value (0x004B2A40), bits 12-16 a 5-bit value (0x004B29B0), bits 17-31 a 15-bit value (0x004B2930); the dword at +0x30 carries a 10-bit field at bits 22-31 with mask 0xFF3FFFFF (0x004B2B10). Writers preserve the bits they do not own.

compatibility_contracts.name: InitSentinelContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Object initialization must zero the byte fields at +0x0/+0x1/+0x41/+0x61, initialize the sub-object at +0x90 (via 0x004FF670 and ThunkWithStructInitSubCalls 0x004FFFA0), and write the sentinel 0xF49C952E (flt_5ACD10) into the three consecutive dwords at +0x84/+0x88/+0x8C.

compatibility_contracts.name: SmallStructZeroContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The 10-byte struct cleared by SmallStructZeroInitializer must have its dwords at +0x0 and +0x4 and its word at +0x8 zeroed; 0x004B4460 is the unconditional initializer, 0x004B4450 the pass-through wrapper invoking it.

compatibility_contracts.name: StreamValueHeaderContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The stream-value reader (0x004B4360) must preserve the header/value/payload buffer contract: a 4-byte header read from the backend at v3, a float value at v3+4 (either a2 raw or a stream byte scaled by dbl_5ACD28 = 0.0001670000056037679 plus a2), and a payload of (header >> 8) & 0x3FF bytes read into v3+8.

Equal byte offsets on distinct this bases are NOT merged into one class unless the shared layout is argued.
